method.edge_weight: The number of plastic-related works in the period on which both members are listed. Each work counts once per pair. This is a count of shared works, not a fraction.
method.rounding: Shares, density, clustering, modularity and quantiles are rounded to 4 decimal places. Counts are whole numbers.

ascertainment_note: This build covers the California Atlas corpus only: the plastic-related works in the published index. The corpus is built around California authors. The build also counts how many plastic-related works in the file have no California author. Collaborators outside California appear only through works they co-wrote with California researchers. A co-author who is not on the Atlas author list is therefore not a member, and a California author whose only plastic-related co-authors are off that list is counted as having no links. The measures describe how California plastics research is connected, as the Atlas records it. They do not describe the whole field, and they should not be compared with a network built from a broader set of works.

definitions.windows: Plastic-related works are grouped by publication year. 'All years' includes every plastic-related work, including works from before 2011 and works with no year. The periods 2011-2015, 2016-2020 and 2021-2025 include both end years. 2026 is a partial period: the year was still running when the figures were built. Works from before 2011 appear only in 'All years'.
definitions.author_graph: Members are Atlas authors on the Atlas author list who appear on at least one plastic-related work in the period. Two authors are linked when they are listed on the same work. Co-authors who are not on the Atlas author list are not members and create no links.
definitions.institution_graph: Members are institutions listed on at least one plastic-related work in the period. Two institutions are linked when they are listed on the same work.
definitions.edge_weight: The number of plastic-related works in the period on which both members are listed. Each work counts once per pair. This is a count of shared works, not a fraction.
definitions.nodes: Members in the period's network, including members with no links.
definitions.edges: Pairs of members that share at least one work in the period.
definitions.components: Connected groups in the period's network. A group is a set of members who can reach each other through links. A member with no links forms a group on its own.
definitions.components_with_edges: Connected groups with at least two members.
definitions.giant_component: The largest connected group, by number of members. Its share is its member count divided by all members.
definitions.density: The share of all possible pairs of members that are linked: twice the number of links, divided by members times (members minus 1). Members with no links are included. Not available when there are fewer than two members.
definitions.average_clustering: The average, across all members, of how closely each member's partners are linked to each other. For one member, this is the share of pairs of its partners that are also linked. Each member counts equally. A member with fewer than two partners, including every member with no links, counts as 0.
definitions.isolates: Members with no link to any other member in the period. For authors: no other Atlas author shares a plastic-related work with them in the period. This happens with single-author works, or when their co-authors are not on the Atlas author list. For institutions: no other institution is listed with them on any work in the period. The share is the number of these members divided by all members.
definitions.degree: The number of different partners each member has, counting each partner once. Members with no links are included. The quantiles interpolate between sorted values: minimum, 25th percentile, median, 75th percentile, 90th percentile and maximum.
definitions.communities: The number of clusters found automatically with the Louvain method. The method starts from a fixed point, so the same data gives the same clusters. Members with no links are left out.
definitions.modularity: A score for how well the clusters separate the links. Each link counts in proportion to the number of works it shares. Not available when the period has no links. Members with no links do not change the score.
definitions.cross_institution: The share of links whose two members share no institution. For authors, a link is counted only when both authors list an institution. For institutions, every link joins two different institutions, so this share is always 100%.
definitions.cross_sector: The share of links whose two members belong to different sectors. Each institution has a sector. An author's sectors are those of their institutions, and a link counts as cross-sector when the two authors share no sector. Institutions marked 'other' have no sector, so they are not used; that covers every institution outside California. A link is counted only when both ends have a sector.
definitions.out_of_region: The share of links with one member outside California. For authors, this means the author is not currently in California. For institutions, it means the institution is not in California. A link is counted only when both ends are known. An author whose current location is not known is not counted.
definitions.fractions: Each share comes with the number of links it was judged on: the links where that check can be made. A share is not available when no link can be checked.
definitions.rounding: Shares, density, clustering, modularity and quantiles are rounded to 4 decimal places. Counts are whole numbers.
